The food looks like sliced sausage (kielbasa-style chunks) on a small paper plate or bowl, roughly 18 cm across. I count about 13 half-round pieces, each roughly 12–15 g, which gives about 180 g total. Smoked sausage runs around 300 kcal per 100 g, so this comes to roughly 540 kcal; I've rounded that down slightly.
